tagline: Loryma Cup 2027 — an offshore regatta around the Datça peninsula: four long passage races, night watches and a week of living on board. No experience needed: two professional racers will teach you to handle a yacht on the open sea.

included: Charter of a racing yacht for the whole week, with accommodation on board
Entry fee for Loryma Cup 2027 — 4 races
Two professional sailors — a skipper and a tactician
Fuel and marina berths along the race route
Briefings, theory, training and masterclasses on the water
extras: Provisions for the boat — bought together, usually 80–120 € per person for the week
Restaurants on the free day and personal expenses
A hotel before or after the regatta — optional, we will help you book it

conditions.label: Lodging
conditions.text: We live on the yacht all week: falling asleep to the sound of the waves and waking up in a new bay. No hotel or transfers are needed during the regatta

harbor.note: Regatta port — Marmaris, Turkey. Loryma Cup, 1–8 May 2027. Boarding on Saturday, we leave the yacht the following Saturday at 10:00, the prize-giving is at 18:00.

itinerary.title: The Loryma Cup week, day by day

summary.title: A loop around the Datça peninsula

itinerary.intro: These are not short sprints within sight of the shore but a real sea adventure: long passages between the bays of the Datça peninsula, watches at the helm, working with the wind and the currents. Some legs are sailed after dark — a night watch, the lights of the coast and a sky full of stars. Along the way: wild beaches, clear water and fishing villages. Two active racing sailors look after safety and tactics and teach everything from hoisting sails to night navigation.

days.label: 1 May, Sat
days.title: Arrival day
days.text: We arrive in Marmaris and move onto the yacht. We meet the team, share out the cabins and head out for a first training session, practising manoeuvres.

days.label: 2 May, Sun
days.title: Final training
days.text: Briefing, theory and a study of the route at 11:00. From 12:00 to 17:00 — the final training session before the start.

days.label: 3 May, Mon
days.title: Race 1: Marmaris → Körmen
days.text: A long passage along the coast. We finish in the scenic bay of Körmen and spend the night at anchor.

days.label: 4 May, Tue
days.title: Free day
days.text: We rest, swim in the clear water and wander around the village of Körmen. You can have lunch at a local taverna with fresh fish.

days.label: 5 May, Wed
days.title: Race 2: Palamutbükü → Körmen
days.text: We sail over to the famous Palamutbükü beach and start from there. One of the most beautiful legs of the regatta.

days.label: 6 May, Thu
days.title: Race 3: Körmen → Datça
days.text: A long offshore passage to the town of Datça: night navigation and work for the whole crew.

days.label: 7 May, Fri
days.title: Race 4: Datça → Marmaris
days.text: The final long passage back to Marmaris and the ceremonial finish of the regatta.

days.label: 8 May, Sat
days.title: Prize-giving
days.text: In the morning we get the yacht ready for handover and leave the boat at 10:00. At 18:00 — the prize-giving ceremony and a gala dinner with the regatta sailors.

itinerary.note: No experience is required: you can take home not just a medal but real seagoing skills. The race schedule is set by the organisers and the weather — the order of the legs may shift.
